2 in 1 Game Pack - Tony Hawk's Undergrou.name: 2 In 1 Game Pack: Tony Hawk's Underground + Kelly Slater's Pro Surfer
2 in 1 Game Pack - Tony Hawk's Undergrou.summary: A compilation of two extreme sports games on a single cartridge.

Celeste Classic.name: Celeste Classic
Celeste Classic.summary: An almost direct conversion of the prototype game Celeste Classic to the Game Boy Advance.

J.League Pocket 2.name: J.League Pocket 2
J.League Pocket 2.summary: J.League Pocket 2 is a Sports game, developed by KCEO and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2002.

Mario Golf - GBA Tour.name: Mario Golf: Advance Tour
Mario Golf - GBA Tour.summary: Grab your clubs and start down the road to golfing perfection in this role-playing golf adventure! Chat up the locals at golf clinics, hone your skills in challenges like Club Slots and Go-Go Gates, and try to become the champ of all the country clubs! The Mushroom Kingdom residents take on only the very best.

Rebelstar - Tactical Command.name: Rebelstar: Tactical Command
Rebelstar - Tactical Command.summary: You can play as the leader of a revolt in the turn-based strategy game Rebelstar: Tactical Command. The Arelian Empire seized control of Earth 70 years ago and has since become an oppressive regime, controlling the world with fear and marauding shock troops. You can fight back by equipping a team of rebels and controlling them in battle. Rebelstar: Tactical Command includes campaign, skirmish, multiplayer hotseat, and multiplayer link mode.

Super Mario Advance 2 - Super Mario Worl.name: Super Mario World: Super Mario Advance 2
Super Mario Advance 2 - Super Mario Worl.summary:
Super Mario Advance 2: Super Mario World is a remake of Super Mario World for the Game Boy Advance starring Mario's dinosaur friend Yoshi for the first time.

Super Mario Advance is a four-part series for the GBA with Super Mario games of the NES and SNES era. The remakes came with adjusted graphics, sound and additional content. Each game of the series includes additionally the arcade-classic "Mario Bros" which can be played in multiplayer via link cable.

Yu-Gi-Oh! - Reshef of Destruction.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Reshef of Destruction
Yu-Gi-Oh! - Reshef of Destruction.summary: In your return to Battle City, you begin another mission to retrieve stolen millennium cards that can destroy the world. Yu-Gi-Oh! Reshef of Destruction features an all-new storyline that sets you off on a quest to stop Reshef from drowning the world in darkness. Since the game's battles are fought with cards, you must build a strong deck from 800 different cards (including all three Egyptian god cards) to even stand a chance against your enemies.
